title: First coefficient of a restricted Boolean function
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^4\to\{-1,1\}$ take value $+1$ precisely when $x_2=x_3=-1$, or when the four coordinates are weakly decreasing, or when they are weakly increasing; otherwise let $f(x)=-1$. Restrict $f$ by fixing coordinates $2$ and $3$ to $+1$ and $-1$, respectively, leaving coordinates $0$ and $1$ free. The Fourier coefficient of this restricted real-valued function on the singleton coordinate set $\{0\}$ is $\frac12$.
